title: Project script.json
description: Content manifest for one video: format, scene breakdown, and where each scene's voiceover comes from. This is data the engine's Remotion components read — it is not itself a Remotion file.

format.description: See engine/remotion/formats.ts. "vertical" (1080x1920) is the default for Facebook/Reels.

text.description: Narration / on-screen text for this scene.

durationInFrames.description: Set once the scene's audio duration is known (from voiceover.file or TTS output). Left null while only text exists.

voiceover.description: Voiceover is always a local audio file at render time — this engine never calls a TTS provider directly. A separate, optional module can populate voiceover.file from a script.

file.description: Path relative to this project's public/ folder, e.g. "public/audio/scene1.mp3".

manim.description: Optional path to a rendered Manim clip for this scene, relative to public/, e.g. "public/manim-render/scene3.mp4".
